message: AXTAG key typo on `w`: unrecognised key `restrct`; did you mean `restrict`?
help: an unrecognised key is recorded and never checked, so the claim this looks like was not made; the keys that are checked are `effect(...)` (purity is `effect(pure)`), `restrict(...)`, `pre(...)`, `post(...)`, `isr` and `unhandled(trap)` on an `effect` declaration
